canonical_title: Flight beyond the service flight envelope

versions.title_at_revision: Flight beyond the service flight envelope
versions.text:
Standard: Flight beyond the SFE that does not involve structural failure or unrecoverable loss of rotor RPM is recoverable to the SFE without undue pilot skill. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the handling qualities that result from transient excursions from, and subsequent recoveries to, the SFE for each air vehicle configuration and loading. Perform intentional excursions from the SFE (e.g., airspeed, bank angle, Nz, Nr, sideslip, CG) and evaluate the handling qualities of recovery to the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the handling qualities that result from transient excursions from, and subsequent recoveries to, the SFE for each air vehicle configuration and loading. Perform intentional excursions from the SFE (e.g., airspeed, bank angle, Nz, Nr, sideslip, CG) and evaluate the handling qualities of recovery to the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the handling qualities that result from transient excursions from, and subsequent recoveries to, the SFE for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading. Perform intentional excursions from the SFE (e.g., airspeed, bank angle, Nz, Nr, sideslip, CG) and evaluate the handling qualities of recovery to the SFE.
